items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: we had two bass players for awhile. Oh, Jimmy was terrific.

ctx.x: And it became a solo vehicle for you, for Johnny Hodges, for Willie Smith, for Harry Carney and for anybody else?
Ah, Blanton and well almost everybody that was soloing, made some sort of a record of 'Sophisticated Lady.'
And you were saying that there were take-offs from portion of it, by whom?
